description: Review and testimonial cards for beauty salons and hairstylists.

entries.author: Sample entry
entries.text: She listened to what I wanted, fixed the color two other salons got wrong, and my hair has never looked better.

entries.author: Sample entry
entries.text: Booked at lunch, in the chair on time, and the blowout lasted all weekend. This is my salon now.

entries.author: Sample entry
entries.text: First stylist who told me the truth about my hair and then gave me a cut that actually grows out well.

entries.author: Sample entry
entries.text: I came in nervous about going short. I left with the best haircut of my life and three strangers asking where I got it done. Worth every penny, every single time.
